recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not revert later EvidenceVariable refinements while auditing FHIR-48665; handle FHIR-55066 terminology migration separately when that issue is in scope.
issue_request: FHIR-48665 was an Applied/Persuasive CDS change request to add EvidenceVariable elements for research study data dictionary use: conditional, classifier, dataStorage with datatype/path, timing, period, a constraint backbone with acceptability limits, missingDataMeaning, unacceptableDataHandling, and associated example/preferred bindings.
initial_application: The request was applied before this reconciliation by 7cd41b77cee059c722914aa5f34494243d9a56c0, which added the requested differential elements; 0bc301f872edc9c08196428c1144016c1bda0e54, which added bindings and supporting terminology and moved datatype under dataStorage; and 51886f966ddddd1b3be7ce3ef9f1e5b9a620b762, which corrected dataStorage.path from Citation to EvidenceVariable. PR HL7/fhir#3201 merged after review on 2024-11-25.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists EvidenceVariable as an active resource and lists the relevant children in the active hierarchy. Later Applied issues refined the same model: FHIR-49755 intentionally changed several shorts/definitions and EvidenceVariable.missingDataMeaning cardinality, while FHIR-49077 and FHIR-49875 added dataStorage.component and dataStorage.delimiter. FHIR-55066 is later terminology migration/background context and was not decided here.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current StructureDefinition contains all 22 FHIR-48665 requested element ids, and the relevant classifier, constraint, and unacceptable-data-handling terminology XML files are present and parseable.
